# PhoneKoi (phonekoi.com)

> Community-Driven IMEI Verification, Stolen Phone Blacklist & Device Fraud Prevention Network in Bangladesh.

## Overview
PhoneKoi is Bangladesh's primary consumer protection platform for mobile devices. Before purchasing second-hand or imported smartphones, buyers verify IMEI numbers against official Police GD (General Diary) records, community theft blacklists, and algorithmic integrity checks.

## Key Services
- **Instant IMEI Search**: https://phonekoi.com/check or https://phonekoi.com/result/{imei}
- **Report Stolen or Lost Phone**: https://phonekoi.com/report (requires Police GD number and device verification)
- **Supported Brands**: Apple iPhone (iPhone 16 Pro Max, iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 14, iPhone 13, iPhone 12, iPhone 11, etc.), Samsung (Galaxy S24, S23, Ultra, A-series, Z Fold/Flip), Xiaomi (Redmi Note, Poco, Mi series), Vivo, Oppo, Realme, OnePlus, Google Pixel.
- **Verification Engine**:
  - Luhn checksum algorithmic validation.
  - Multi-tier risk engine scoring (Clean, Caution, High Risk, Stolen).
  - Geolocation-tagged theft activity patterns.
  - 1-Number-per-Account policy ensuring authentic user identity.

## Location & Jurisdiction
- Region: Bangladesh (BD)
- Headquarters: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Primary Languages: English (en-BD), Bengali / Banglish (bn-BD)
- Official Website: https://phonekoi.com
